stops.text: Welcome to iBow Business OS. Ten intelligence modules. One operating system. Let's take a look.
LedgerLogic. Finance intelligence. Invoices, cash flow and reports, all connected, so every decision is backed by real numbers.
DesignForge. Design intelligence. Brand systems, UI assets and campaign visuals, in one design workflow built for business momentum.
MarketPulse. Marketing intelligence. It reads audience signals and trends, and turns them into campaign insights and new growth opportunities.
ClientOrbit. Relationship intelligence. Every lead, every customer journey, every signal, in one orbit, so your accounts keep growing.
PeopleGrid. People intelligence. HR workflows, roles and access, all aligned, with a clear view of how your teams perform.
OpsPilot. Operations intelligence. Tasks, delivery and resources in one execution cockpit, taking operations from chaos to clarity.
RiskRadar. Risk intelligence. It scans for risks, raises alerts and maps out safe paths, before a risk becomes a decision.
SimuPath. Simulation intelligence. Model scenarios, predict outcomes, and choose your strategic path before you commit.
SupportSync. Support intelligence. Tickets, chats and workflows, connected to the whole business, for faster resolutions.
VendorBridge. Vendor intelligence. Suppliers, contracts and approvals, connected, so every delivery stays on track.
Ten modules. One operating system. iBow Business OS. Ready when you are.
